mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special kind of oxygen that has three atoms instead of two."
Ozone is a special kind of oxygen that has three atoms instead of two.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an acid precursor, which is a source of acid rain produced when nitrogen oxides combine with water to produce nitric acid, HNO3, and other acids iii."
NOx is an acid precursor, which is a source of acid rain produced when nitrogen oxides combine with water to produce nitric acid, HNO3, and other acids iii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a trans-boundary problem, and perhaps requires trans- national involvement in combating it."
Air pollution is a trans-boundary problem, and perhaps requires trans- national involvement in combating it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an acid precursor, which is a source of acid rain produced when SO2 combines with water droplets to form sulphur acid, H2SO4 iii."
Sulphur dioxide is an acid precursor, which is a source of acid rain produced when SO2 combines with water droplets to form sulphur acid, H2SO4 iii.
fib: ______ is a kind of greenhouse gas.
Carbon dioxide is a kind of greenhouse gas.
______ is an act in which displeasing human - or machine created sound that disrupts the activity of balance of human or animal life is introduced to the environment.
Noise pollution is an act in which displeasing human - or machine created sound that disrupts the activity of balance of human or animal life is introduced to the environment.
______ are the precursors of nitrate particulates (nitrates) which affect the radiation balance of the atmosphere and can contribute to global cooling iv.
Nitrogen oxides are the precursors of nitrate particulates (nitrates) which affect the radiation balance of the atmosphere and can contribute to global cooling iv.
